judged_text: The slug spread condition was inverted from !IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug } to IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {}, so the Organization create no longer receives a slug when team billing is disabled. On every deployment with IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED false (the default for self-hosted installs), Prisma rejects the create because the required slug argument is missing and organization creation returns a 500; with the flag true the slug is additionally assigned immediately, bypassing the requestedSlug approval gating that the adjacent metadata line implements.
